instrument: Site plan extension SPE23-12-01 (Planning & Zoning Commission, Jan 9, 2024)
summary: Compass requested an extension of its 2023 site plan beyond the code's one-year validity, open-ended until its matters with APS are resolved. Staff listed no stipulations, no City Council action, and no action required under the military-airport land use compatibility statute.
text: until all matters with Arizona Public Services (APS) are resolved

source.citation: City of El Mirage P&Z agenda packet, Jan 9, 2024, item 3.2 and staff report SPE23-12-01

notes: Staff report fields: Stipulations: None; City Council: No action is required; ARS 28-8481 Land Use Compatibility: No action is required. CONFLICT: agenda item names the submitter as H&H Capital Acquisitions; staff report names Compass Data Centers / DPML Copperwing Land Co II LLC. Status left as proposed because the Jan 9, 2024 P&Z vote was not read; the Aug 2026 final plat and development agreement indicate the entitlement remained alive.
confidence_note: P&Z outcome on Jan 9, 2024 not read (minutes in a later packet).
